headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 5 studies yielded an effect size of 1.0 (95% CI: 0.63–1.61), indicating no statistically significant association between lutein and prostate cancer\aggressive. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 84.22%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
